## History

Minnie May contracted a severe case of croup while her parents were away from home. Relying on her past experience nursing twins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cared for Minnie May through the night until [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrived with a doctor. Minnie May's recovery earned her mother's gratitude and helped restore the friendship between [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saves Minnie May's life when the child contracts a severe case of croup while her parents are away. Relying on her previous experience caring for twins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) nurses Minnie May through the night until a doctor arrives, an act of care that earns the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) family's lasting gratitude.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), +1 more_
